system.description:
The roads are the city's veins, and someone must ride them with a lance. Perhaps you were a squire of the Order of the Hawk who raised a beast from the egg in the Citadel's deep stables, a knight who outlived the other nine of your lance, or a Hawk-Marshal's bastard who took the oath without the blessing. You wear iron, ride iron, and meet the dark head-on, because the convoys behind you cannot outrun it. Few of you die old, and fewer still die in the city.

Class feature: Sworn to the Saddle
You are bound to a destrier: a warhorse, or something stranger from the deep stables, scaled or feathered or without a name the Order will speak aloud. Whatever its shape, it uses the Destrier stat block below. It is a permanent Moderate minion and counts toward your minion limit. While you ride it, you move it with your own Move actions as a mount (see Subsystem: Vehicles), and command it (◈) only to make it attack or use its active ability. In the saddle, you attack at normal speed without the +2 DR for attacking from a moving mount, and you ignore the Agility and defence penalties of armour up to tier 3 (tier 4 still defends at +2 DR). If your destrier dies, you can bind yourself to a new one only by raising or breaking it during Downtime (a horse costs 80 s; stranger beasts cost what the Dark Master asks).

Class power: Couched Charge 🟒1 ◈◈
